ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.40:0.60 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe is characterized by a contiguous high-intensity field with sparse, low-intensity circular focal spots near the trailing edge. Right lobe is characterized by a dominant low-intensity field with sparse, high-intensity linear features and mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50-55 degrees and significant depth relative to the fluke vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5-15 pixels along the continuous trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary concave curve extending from the median notch toward the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, textured circular clusters (barnacle colonization) localized on the distal tips and right lateral margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-intensity, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated on the low-intensity surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcareous encrustations (barnacles) on distal tips and significant linear scarring on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pigmentation asymmetry between the left lobe (high-intensity dominant) and the right lobe (low-intensity dominant).
